contracts.name: fields and formats
contracts.surface: Fixed, variable, escaped and packed fields; composed TLV/LTV Formats; capability/constructed inspection and exact source preservation.
contracts.limitations: Declarative immutable snapshots. No arbitrary Go format callbacks, custom terminated-value resolvers or native descriptor borrowing.

contracts.name: readers and visitors
contracts.surface: Sequential and tree readers, incremental windows, borrowed nodes/events, bounded traversal and resumable Go visitors.
contracts.limitations: Go manages sequential cursors; borrowed bytes must remain stable. Callback errors/panics remain in Go, and mutable cursors are not concurrently usable.

contracts.name: writers and copies
contracts.surface: Canonical element/tree/event encoding and measurement, exact encoded copies, original framing preservation and capacity retry.
contracts.limitations: Go owns staging and output. No native callback replay, borrowed scratch or allocation-free guarantee. Go slices replace raw value/byte copy APIs.

contracts.name: definitions
contracts.surface: Immutable application-selected DefinitionRegistry; first exact tag match with owned names and result bytes.
contracts.limitations: Names are descriptive, empty means unnamed; lookup does not validate tags, resolve domains or select codecs. Native storage is reclaimed by shared Go ownership.

contracts.name: diagnostics and result identity
contracts.surface: Owned typed diagnostic snapshots, canonical names, errors.Is/errors.As and checked Location creation/translation/Value resolution.
contracts.limitations: No borrowed producer-side context/path mutation ABI or exact native path formatter. Exported snapshot enrichment does not mutate error identity or automatically synchronize Offset fields.

contracts.name: documents
contracts.surface: Owned mutable documents, node navigation/identity, source metadata, subtree encoding and resumable exact-path visitors.
contracts.limitations: Explicit shared Close; edits invalidate node generations. Builder scratch and native retirement/revision pointer APIs are internal, with no resumable public Document Builder.

contracts.name: queries
contracts.surface: Exact paths/matchers, compiled programs, typed providers/bindings, copied images, window execution, retained results and transactional document edits.
contracts.limitations: No borrowed/aligned hand-authored native plans or frontend-disabled builds. Images are Core-version-specific; Go storage/callback adapters replace native variants.

contracts.name: structural and query schemas
contracts.surface: Copied recursive prepared structural definitions, bounded reports with owned typed findings, and Query Schema validation.
contracts.limitations: Close invalidates shared prepared owners. Native mutable borrowed graphs and length-entry lookup are represented by Go definition tables; no native allocator callback ABI.

contracts.name: codecs and scalar constraints
contracts.surface: Generic bytes/text/digits/integer/IPv4 and Schema-aware numbers, copied scalar constraints, structured object conversions via Go callbacks.
contracts.limitations: No protocol-specific codec parity claim. Callbacks bound their own allocations and return application errors unchanged; native callback constructors are used indirectly.

contracts.name: wire generation
contracts.surface: Immutable copied candidates, deterministic seed/case-index mapping, bounded native scratch and owned generated results.
contracts.limitations: Wire-format generation, not Schema-valid or protocol-valid data; no allocation-free guarantee. Candidates must be independently composable.

contracts.name: Go storage primitives
contracts.surface: Go byte slices, length, bytes equality/copy and checked conversions; Core performs wire conversion through fields, formats and codecs.
contracts.limitations: No duplicate facade for raw C storage/endian helpers or arbitrary native pointers; source-reference exclusions are not promises of allocation-free C storage parity.
